result.summary: The page generally renders correctly. The partially visible category chip and clipped restaurant card/title at the right edge, plus the bottom-cut pizza card, are intentional scroll/viewport indicators and were excluded. No critical or major visual breakage is apparent; only minor legibility concerns remain.

issues.description: Secondary metadata text such as delivery fees and ETA labels (e.g., '€0.90 delivery', '€2.40 delivery') uses light gray on white and may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Increase the contrast of secondary text to meet WCAG AA contrast ratios while preserving the visual hierarchy.

issues.description: Search placeholder text 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is low-contrast light gray and may be difficult to see, especially in bright conditions.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder color or add a clearer search hint/icon affordance so the input purpose remains legible.
